patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks 'how many SDGs' (17), target year (2030), year adopted (2015) - at least ten near-identical items.
Goal number -> title is the next most common shape (Goal 1 No Poverty, 2 Zero Hunger, 4 Quality Education, 6 Water & Sanitation, 8 Decent Work), plus 'which is NOT an SDG' (e.g. 'Life in sky').
Match items pair SDGs with descriptions, socio-economic challenges or Indian schemes (Namami Gange = SDG 6, Ujjwala = clean energy, Ayushman Bharat = health, Samagra Shiksha = education).
APPSC also asks SDG India Index (NITI Aayog) results: weakest goals (2 and 5 in 2020-21) and drivers of improvement (6 and 7).
App's MCQs mirror these well but add origins (Rio+20, Colombia-Guatemala) and 2026 SDR data; PYQs use simple single-number answers.
